kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Stephen Miller will replace Susie Wiles as Trump's chief of staff
wire.summary: The chance comes after sweeping Republican losses in the midterm elections.

wire.title: Pope Leo begins a 12-day, 3-country South America tour after his cancer surgery
wire.summary: After lung surgery, Pope Leo embarks on a 12-day tour of South America, navigating political tensions and returning to Peru, the place he once called home.

wire.title: Health intel-sharing group warns industry in wake of cyberattack on French blood bank
wire.summary: A healthcare intelligence-sharing organization is warning its members to lock down systems following cyberattacks on cold storage systems, including a French blood bank.

wire.title: Remembering 'Star Trek' actor Patrick Stewart
wire.summary: Stewart, who died Oct. 28, performed with the Royal Shakespeare Company before becoming famous as Star Trek's Picard. Critic David Bianculli has a tribute, and we listen back to a 2020 interview.

wire.title: European air traffic is targeted by new threats after a week of hoaxes
wire.summary: Officials across Europe reported a fresh slew of bomb threats against multiple flights on Friday, following a string of hoaxes that have caused flight diversions this week. Two broadcasters also received security threats.

wire.title: The leader of a Kenyan doomsday cult is sentenced to 200 years in prison
wire.summary: Cult leader Paul Mackenzie was convicted of murdering 190 children and one adult after he ordered his followers to starve themselves to death in order to meet Jesus.

wire.title: Ex-lawmaker gets 12.5 years in Macao's first national security case
wire.summary: Au's arrest last year was the first publicly known prosecution under Macao's national security law since it was enacted in 2009.

wire.title: Hiring jumps: The economy added 165,000 jobs last month
wire.summary: The U.S. job market improved last month, according to a report from the Labor Department Friday. Employers added more jobs than forecasters had expected and the unemployment rate dipped to 4.1%.

wire.title: Judge halts construction of Trump's arch. And, Labor Department to release jobs report
wire.summary: A judge has blocked construction of Trump's arch moments after it won federal approval to proceed. And, the Labor Department is set to release the latest jobs report today, a day after stocks plunged.

wire.title: Why gold prices are surprisingly low
wire.summary: Gold tends to go up when there's uncertainty in the economy. For a while, the price reflected that. But this week, it dropped from a nearly $5,600 in January to below $4,000. What's going on?

wire.title: AI stocks climb after trillions wiped from market values
wire.summary: Investors had been selling off tech shares in part due to concerns the Democrat election victory would mean slower AI development.

wire.title: Four midterms takeaways for 2028 White House race
wire.summary: The buzz about the presidential election is already under way - here's what we learned this week.

wire.title: Two dead after bus crashes in France, officials say
wire.summary: One child and one young adult were killed in the crash, local authorities say, with more injured.

wire.title: New wave of bomb threats hit European airlines
wire.summary: No link has been established between the threats against the airlines and those against the media outlets.

wire.title: Kenyan doomsday cult leader given life sentence for murdering 191 people
wire.summary: Paul Mackenzie ordered his followers to starve their children to death in a forest so they could "meet Jesus".

wire.title: Judge blocks construction of Trump's massive arch after federal agency approval
wire.summary: The Trump administration had hoped the construction of the 250-foot arch could begin as early as this week.
